# Ruby Gillis

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P56](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0056)</sub>
- **Role:** teacher (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P59](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0059), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P60](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0060)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Susan](../character/susan.md) (sibling)

## Appearance

Ruby Gillis is known for her showy appearance, featuring a plump figure, a brilliant complexion, and large, bright-blue eyes. Her looks are characterized by a notable snap and color, and she wears her yellow hair in a long braid.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P43](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0043), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001)_

## Personality

Ruby Gillis is a cheerful, good-tempered, and rather sentimental individual who frankly enjoys life's pleasantries, though she is also inclined to hysterics. She harbors a mortal dread of fat green caterpillars. Highly focused on romance, she thinks and talks constantly about young men, the compliments they pay her, and how crazy they are about her. Her long-held motivations include having numerous beaus and a very gay time before settling down, with plans to study to be a teacher and get married after teaching for two years.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P39](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0039), [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. ## History

Ruby Gillis grew up with many big sisters and once used a magic pebble given by old [Mary Joe](../character/mary-joe.md) from the Creek to charm away all her warts. She attended school in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) alongside [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), joining her peers in welcoming [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) back when she returned to class. Ruby also pursued higher education, attending Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#academy) together with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results P18](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0018), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P3](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P17](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0017), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. ## Quotes

> "I don’t mind floating down when there’s two or three of us in the flat and we can sit up. It’s fun then. But to lie down and pretend I was dead—I just couldn’t. I’d die really of fright."
>
> — Ruby Gillis — [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P1](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0001)

> "It makes me feel frightened, girls. Do you suppose it’s really right to act like this? Mrs. Lynde says that all play-acting is abominably wicked."
>
> — Ruby Gillis — [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P13](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0013)

> "What are you going to wear for commencement, Jane?"
>
> — Ruby Gillis — [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P16](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0016)

> "Nor I,"
>
> — Ruby Gillis — [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P1](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0001)

> "Oh, she does look really dead,"
>
> — Ruby Gillis — [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P13](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0013)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--ruby-gillis.md)

Ruby is a schoolmate and friend of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). Along with the other pupils, she greets [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) warmly with gifts when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to school following her initial self-imposed absence.
